nodes.text: #68 : [Er68d] [Er88c,p.102] [Er90] [Er97e] [Er97f] number theory | irrationality The decimal expansion is A331373 in the OEIS. Weisenberg has observed that this sum can also be written as\[\sum_{k\geq 1}\sum_{n\geq 2}\frac{1}{(n!)^k}.\]Erdős [Er88c] notes that $\sum \frac{1}{n!+t}$ should be transcendental for every integer $t$.
